case.summary: Analyst review for case HHG-007 indicates a confirmed fraud verdict driven by an account takeover pattern, yielding a calibrated fraud probability of 0.97. The transaction exhibits classic compromise indicators, including multiple online transactions on a newly established identifier within a tight forty-eight-hour window, combined with prior confirmed fraud history on both the specific card tuple and a separate card associated with the customer. Furthermore, the cardholder explicitly denies making the transaction, directly contradicting the recurring cadence and in-person channel history. Although retrieved historical comparables demonstrate cleared alerts involving verified travel, the overwhelming risk indicators in this instance override baseline model decile scoring. Consequently, the policy engine has enforced the necessary protective measures by executing a card block and creating a formal case for HHG-007.
